title: The Johnson & Johnson Vaccine Pause Explained

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会上，在现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在 11 月 18 日在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望大家能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is A Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天是。

sentences.en: The decision-making process that led the U.S.
sentences.zh: 导致美国

sentences.en: government to suspend the use of Johnson & Johnson's
sentences.zh: 政府暂停使用强生公司

sentences.en: COVID-19 vaccine, how long it may last, and the impact it could have.
sentences.zh: 新冠疫苗的决策过程、可能持续的时间及其带来的影响。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, science reporter Carl Zimmer.
sentences.zh: 我采访了我的同事、科学记者卡尔·齐默。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, April 15th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 4 月 15 日，星期四。

sentences.en: Carl, walk us through how this very big decision was reached to pause vaccinations with Johnson & Johnson's vaccine in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 卡尔，请为我们介绍一下，美国是如何做出暂停使用强生疫苗这一重大决定的？

sentences.en: Where does that story start?
sentences.zh: 这个故事是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: The story starts in Europe with another vaccine, one that's made by AstraZeneca.
sentences.zh: 故事始于欧洲的另一款疫苗，由阿斯利康制造。

sentences.en: AstraZeneca is going into widespread use in Europe.
sentences.zh: 阿斯利康正在欧洲各地广泛使用。

sentences.en: It's not yet authorized in the United States.
sentences.zh: 它尚未在美国获得授权。

sentences.en: And after a while, the European regulators notice a few rare cases of blood clots, which start to get them concerned.
sentences.zh: 一段时间后，欧洲监管机构注意到了一些罕见的血栓病例，这开始引起他们的关注。

sentences.en: And so they begin to investigate whether that has anything to do with the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们开始调查这是否与该疫苗有关。

sentences.en: With the AstraZeneca vaccine.
sentences.zh: 即阿斯利康疫苗。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So blood clots are a surprisingly common thing.
sentences.zh: 所以血栓是一种出奇地常见的现象。

sentences.en: Thousands of people get blood clots every day.
sentences.zh: 每天都有数千人患上血栓。

sentences.en: So just because people who get vaccinated get a blood clot, that doesn't really tell you anything in particular about whether the vaccine is dangerous.
sentences.zh: 因此，仅仅因为接种疫苗的人出现血栓，并不能真正说明该疫苗是否危险。

sentences.en: You have to take a closer look.
sentences.zh: 你必须仔细观察。

sentences.en: And when European regulators took a closer look at people getting vaccinated, they noticed that there's
sentences.zh: 当欧洲监管机构仔细观察接种疫苗的人时，他们注意到

sentences.en: a small amount of people who are all getting the same unusual kind of blood clot.
sentences.zh: 有一小部分人都出现了同一种罕见的血栓。

sentences.en: They were taking place in the brain.
sentences.zh: 它们发生在脑部。

sentences.en: And they were associated with very low levels of something called platelets.
sentences.zh: 并且它们与一种叫做血小板的物质水平极低有关。

sentences.en: And what are platelets?
sentences.zh: 什么是血小板？

sentences.en: Platelets are a component of the clotting process in our bloodstream.
sentences.zh: 血小板是我们血液中凝血过程的一个组成部分。

sentences.en: So when we get little wounds in our blood vessels, platelets jump into the wound and basically create a little patch.
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们的血管出现小伤口时，血小板会冲进伤口，基本上形成一个小补丁。

sentences.en: And that allows us to heal.
sentences.zh: 这使我们能够愈合。

sentences.en: So that's good.
sentences.zh: 所以这是好事。

sentences.en: What's bad is when the platelets start to form a big clot, which can then break loose and go around in our bloodstream and end up in dangerous places like in our brains.
sentences.zh: 坏事是当血小板开始形成大血栓时，血栓会脱落并在我们的血液中循环，最终到达危险的地方，比如大脑。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And so what puzzled and concerned European regulators is that you had this very strange condition where you had a combination of these particular kinds of clots with low platelets.
sentences.zh: 因此，令欧洲监管机构感到困惑和担忧的是，这种非常奇怪的情况表现为这些特定类型的血栓与低血小板同时出现。

sentences.en: So they thought maybe we're looking at a rare but distinct and serious condition.
sentences.zh: 所以他们认为，我们可能面对的是一种罕见但独特且严重的病情。

sentences.en: Now, it's not clear why in these people they're getting brain clots along with low platelets.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚为什么这些人会同时出现脑血栓和血小板减少症。

sentences.en: One idea is that all the platelets in the blood are going into these clots.
sentences.zh: 有一种观点认为，血液中的所有血小板都进入了这些血栓中。

sentences.en: And so their level of platelets is going down.
sentences.zh: 因此它们的血小板水平正在下降。

sentences.en: This is a hypothesis that's coming out of the first studies of people who have gotten vaccinated with AstraZeneca and have developed these peculiar
sentences.zh: 这是一个假说，源于对首批接种阿斯利康疫苗并出现这些伴有低血小板的特殊

sentences.en: blood clots with the low platelets.
sentences.zh: 血栓患者的研究。

sentences.en: Okay, so how do we get to Johnson & Johnson?
sentences.zh: 好的，那我们是怎么扯到强生公司的？

sentences.en: European regulators start to wonder if they could get some clues to what's happening with AstraZeneca
sentences.zh: 欧洲监管机构开始琢磨，能否通过观察强生疫苗来获得一些线索，

sentences.en: by looking at the Johnson & Johnson vaccine, because it's similar in some ways to AstraZeneca.
sentences.zh: 弄清楚阿斯利康发生了什么，因为它们在某些方面很相似。

sentences.en: They use the same basic technology, unlike Moderna and Pfizer.
sentences.zh: 与莫德纳和辉瑞不同，它们使用相同的基础技术。

sentences.en: So last week, they start to look at data from the United States.
sentences.zh: 所以上周，他们开始查看来自美国的数据。

sentences.en: Now, at first, there isn't a lot of data that really points to something similar happening with Johnson & Johnson.
sentences.zh: 起初，并没有大量数据真正指向强生公司发生类似情况。

sentences.en: But over the weekend, that changed.
sentences.zh: 但在周末，情况变了。

sentences.en: By the weekend, the CDC and the FDA have gotten six reports that are very similar to what European regulators were seeing with AstraZeneca.
sentences.zh: 到周末时，疾控中心和食药监局已经收到了六份报告，这与欧洲监管机构在阿斯利康身上看到的情况非常相似。

sentences.en: People who have suffered from this distinctive brain clot combined with low platelets.
sentences.zh: 患者都患有这种独特的脑血栓并伴有血小板减少症。

sentences.en: Six people out of seven million or so who've gotten the Johnson & Johnson vaccine, that's tiny.
sentences.zh: 在接种强生疫苗的约七百万人中只有六个人，这个比例极其微小。

sentences.en: But it's a pretty unusual combination.
sentences.zh: 但这是一个相当罕见的组合。

sentences.en: Also, all of those six people were women, and one of those women actually died of her blood clot.
sentences.zh: 而且，这六个人全都是女性，其中一名女性实际上死于她的血栓。

sentences.en: And so that started to set off alarms in the government that maybe we need to stop and take a close look at what's happening.
sentences.zh: 因此，这开始在政府内部敲响警钟，也许我们需要停下来仔细看看发生了什么。

sentences.en: Okay, and so how do U.S.
sentences.zh: 好的，那么美国

sentences.en: regulators, who have been watching, I'm sure, what was happening in Europe
sentences.zh: 监管机构一直在关注欧洲发生的事情，我确信他们也看到了

sentences.en: with AstraZeneca, how do they start to think about how to respond to this very small, six, number of cases
sentences.zh: 阿斯利康的情况，他们是如何开始思考如何应对强生疫苗接种者中这极少数的六起

sentences.en: cases of blood clots in people who've gotten the Johnson & Johnson vaccine?
sentences.zh: 血栓病例的呢？

sentences.en: Once these six cases had come to light, government officials got together and talked about what their options were.
sentences.zh: 一旦这六起病例曝光，政府官员便聚在一起讨论他们的选择。

sentences.en: And basically, it came down to two.
sentences.zh: 基本上，归结为两个选择。

sentences.en: On the one hand, they could issue a warning.
sentences.zh: 一方面，他们可以发布警告。

sentences.en: In other words, they could let doctors know that they had seen this incredibly rare but very serious condition, vaccination.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他们可以让医生知道他们已经看到了这种极其罕见但非常严重的接种后病症。

sentences.en: And just, you know, have doctors be aware that this is an issue and maybe keep an eye out for it.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，让医生意识到这是一个问题，并可能会密切关注它。

sentences.en: Or they could recommend a pause on vaccination.
sentences.zh: 或者他们可以建议暂停接种。

sentences.en: In other words, they would recommend that doctors and vaccination centers and so on stop for now giving out the Johnson & Johnson vaccine while they investigated it further.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他们会建议医生和疫苗接种中心等暂停分发强生疫苗，同时进行进一步调查。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And those are very different options.
sentences.zh: 这些是非常不同的选择。

sentences.en: I mean, one is essentially send the medical world a memo saying heads up.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，一个是实质上给医学界发一份备忘录，提醒大家注意。

sentences.en: The other is far more significant.
sentences.zh: 另一个则重要得多。

sentences.en: It's stopping temporarily the use of the Johnson
sentences.zh: 那是暂停使用强生

sentences.en: & Johnson vaccine, which of course would be very disruptive.
sentences.zh: 疫苗，这当然会带来极大的干扰。

sentences.en: So what factors are influencing how they are considering these two options?
sentences.zh: 那么，有哪些因素在影响他们对这两种选择的权衡呢？

sentences.en: One important factor is that they were wondering how many more cases out there are there.
sentences.zh: 一个重要的因素是他们在想外面还有多少病例。

sentences.en: So they knew of six, but maybe there were more that people just hadn't reported yet.
sentences.zh: 所以他们知道有六例，但可能还有更多是人们尚未报告的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so if they just give a quiet little warning, people might not pay attention to it.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果他们只是发出一个温和的小警告，人们可能不会注意到它。

sentences.en: But if they say, hey, folks, we're taking this seriously, that might spur doctors and patients and so on to get in touch and say, hey, guess what?
sentences.zh: 但如果他们说，嘿，伙计们，我们正在认真对待这件事，这可能会促使医生和患者等主动联系并说，嘿，你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: I've seen the same thing or I've experienced the same thing.
sentences.zh: 我见过同样的情况，或者我经历过同样的情况。

sentences.en: It's also of concern because there's some indication that some of the standard way to treat
sentences.zh: 这也令人担忧，因为有一些迹象表明，使用一种名为肝素的药物来治疗

sentences.en: a blood clot with a drug called heparin might actually be bad for this particular condition.
sentences.zh: 血栓的某些标准方法可能实际上对这种特定病情有害。

sentences.en: So you really want to make sure that people are aware that there is a potential risk of just treating a blood clot like any other blood clot.
sentences.zh: 所以你真的希望确保人们意识到，像对待任何其他血栓一样治疗血栓存在潜在风险。

sentences.en: That's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: So these regulators are not just worried about the danger of these blood clots, but also about the danger of potentially mistreating them.
sentences.zh: 所以这些监管机构不仅担心这些血栓的危险，还担心可能治疗不当的危险。

sentences.en: They're concerned that this might be a risk.
sentences.zh: 他们担心这可能是一个风险。

sentences.en: You know, again, they have to figure out what's going on.
sentences.zh: 你知道，同样地，他们必须弄清楚发生了什么。

sentences.en: You know, they really have to figure out if this is even a cause and effect that they're looking at.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们真的必须弄清楚这是否确实是他们正在观察的因果关系。

sentences.en: But these kinds of concerns shifts the government officials away from just sending out a warning to actually going for a pause.
sentences.zh: 但这类担忧使得政府官员从仅仅发出警告转变为实际采取暂停措施。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And of course, a pause is what the regulators decide on.
sentences.zh: 当然，暂停正是监管机构决定的结果。

sentences.en: So how do they describe that decision to the American public?
sentences.zh: 那么他们是如何向美国公众描述这一决定的呢？

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And thank you all for joining us.
sentences.zh: 也谢谢大家加入我们。

sentences.en: Tuesday morning, there is a press conference.
sentences.zh: 周二上午，有一场新闻发布会。

sentences.en: This morning, the FDA and CDC announced that out of an abundance of caution, we're recommending a pause in the use of the Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine.
sentences.zh: 今天上午，食药监局和疾控中心宣布，出于谨慎考虑，我们建议暂停使用强生新冠疫苗。

sentences.en: With the acting director of the Food and Drug Administration, Janet Woodcock, and other officials.
sentences.zh: 与食品和药物管理局代理局长珍妮特·伍德考克及其他官员一同出席。

sentences.en: These events appear to be extremely rare.
sentences.zh: 这些事件似乎极为罕见。

sentences.en: And they present the data.
sentences.zh: 他们呈上了数据。

sentences.en: One case was fatal and one patient is in critical condition.
sentences.zh: 一例死亡，一名患者病情危重。

sentences.en: Right now, these events appear to be extremely rare.
sentences.zh: 目前，这些事件似乎极其罕见。

sentences.en: That said, COVID-19 vaccine safety is a top priority for federal government.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，新冠疫苗的安全性是联邦政府的重中之重。

sentences.en: Said that this is very, very rare.
sentences.zh: 表示这非常非常罕见。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, it's serious enough that they have to investigate it.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，它足够严重，以至于他们必须对其进行调查。

sentences.en: We are committed to an expeditious review of the available information.
sentences.zh: 我们致力于对现有信息进行迅速审查。

sentences.en: And expected that this investigation might take only a few days.
sentences.zh: 并预计这项调查可能只需几天时间。

sentences.en: The time frame will depend, obviously, on what we learn in the next few days.
sentences.zh: 时间表显然将取决于我们在接下来的几天里了解到什么。

sentences.en: And during those few days, they recommended that the Johnson & Johnson vaccine be paused.
sentences.zh: 在这几天里，他们建议暂停接种强生疫苗。

sentences.en: This concludes today's media briefing.
sentences.zh: 今天的媒体吹风会到此结束。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And Carl, you just used an important word, recommended.
sentences.zh: 卡尔，你刚才用了一个重要的词，建议。

sentences.en: This is federal guidance.
sentences.zh: 这是联邦指导意见。

sentences.en: It is not a mandate.
sentences.zh: 这不是强制令。

sentences.en: So what is the immediate response to U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，对于美国

sentences.en: health regulators giving the recommendation that the Johnson & Johnson vaccinations be paused?
sentences.zh: 卫生监管机构发出暂停接种强生疫苗的建议，各方作何即时反应？

sentences.en: The effect is really swift.
sentences.zh: 影响真的非常迅速。

sentences.en: The FDA and the CDC has announced that they are now recommending a pause.
sentences.zh: 食药监局和疾控中心宣布他们现在建议暂停。

sentences.en: Walgreens, CVS, and Kroger are among the national pharmacies that also will pause using J&J as well.
sentences.zh: 沃尔格林、CVS 和克罗格是也将暂停使用强生疫苗的全国性药店之列。

sentences.en: Walgreens and CVS both quickly say that they're going to pause using Johnson & Johnson vaccines.
sentences.zh: 沃尔格林和 CVS 均迅速表示将暂停使用强生疫苗。

sentences.en: You might as well view it as a pause nationwide.
sentences.zh: 你大可将其视为全国范围内的暂停。

sentences.en: A number of states do the same thing.
sentences.zh: 许多州也采取了同样的做法。

sentences.en: Signs now flash this message outside the federally supported vaccine site.
sentences.zh: 标志现在在联邦支持的疫苗接种点外闪烁着这个信息。

sentences.en: No J&J here.
sentences.zh: 这里没有强生疫苗。

sentences.en: There's a huge wave of cancellations of appointments to get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 接种疫苗的预约迎来了巨大的取消潮。

sentences.en: It's so rare, the side effects, that I really wasn't worried about it.
sentences.zh: 这些副作用太罕见了，我其实并不担心。

sentences.en: There are mobile vaccination clinics that are just canceled in different cities.
sentences.zh: 有些城市的移动疫苗接种诊所直接被取消了。

sentences.en: I'm just disappointed there's no shot at all, so I'm definitely disappointed.
sentences.zh: 我只是很失望根本打不到疫苗，所以我绝对很失望。

sentences.en: So this has gigantic effects immediately.
sentences.zh: 因此，这立即产生了巨大的影响。

sentences.en: And by the end of Tuesday, Johnson & Johnson vaccination across the United States has pretty much ground to a halt.
sentences.zh: 到周二结束时，全美各地的强生疫苗接种几乎陷入停顿。

sentences.en: Right, and in a sense, what that tells us is that the pause worked, right?
sentences.zh: 没错，从某种意义上说，这告诉我们暂停起作用了，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, pharmacies and states do exactly what the CDC and the FDA have guided them to do.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，药店和各州完全按照疾控中心和食药监局的指导做了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So the pause is happening in exactly the way that government officials had hoped for.
sentences.zh: 因此，暂停的实施方式完全符合政府官员的预期。

sentences.en: But that doesn't mean that there aren't some concerns about what the long-term effects could be of this pause.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着人们不担心这次暂停可能产生的长期影响。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费探索《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你尚未订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用程序并获得 30 天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Carl, once this pause is in effect, it raises tons of questions.
sentences.zh: 卡尔，一旦这项暂停生效，它就会引发无数的问题。

sentences.en: So let's spin through those questions.
sentences.zh: 那么我们来梳理一下这些问题。

sentences.en: The first is, what will be the consequence of the pause on the U.S.
sentences.zh: 第一个问题是，暂停使用美国

sentences.en: vaccination campaign, on the deadlines and the schedule for returning to normalcy?
sentences.zh: 疫苗接种计划，会对恢复正常生活的最后期限和时间表产生什么影响？

sentences.en: Johnson & Johnson has been a crucial component of the Biden administration's plans for getting the United States back to normal.
sentences.zh: 强生公司一直是拜登政府让美国恢复正常计划中的一个关键环节。

sentences.en: They were supposed to be delivering 100 million doses by the end of May.
sentences.zh: 他们原本应该在5月底前交付1億剂疫苗。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And they've already been having some problems with manufacturing their vaccines and had to essentially throw out 50 million doses.
sentences.zh: 而且他们此前在疫苗制造方面已经遇到了一些问题，不得不直接废弃了5000万剂疫苗。

sentences.en: So now, even pausing for a few days can throw that plan into even further uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，哪怕只是暂停几天，也会让那个计划陷入更大的不确定性之中。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So on a logistical, scheduling level, this is a meaningfully big deal.
sentences.zh: 所以在后勤和时间安排层面上，这是一个意义重大的问题。

sentences.en: It's a big deal, especially in parts of the country where the other two vaccines by Moderna and Pfizer are not so easy to give out.
sentences.zh: 这是一个大问题，特别是在该国其他两种由莫德纳和辉瑞生产的疫苗不太容易分发的地区。

sentences.en: And what kinds of places would those be?
sentences.zh: 那会是哪些地方呢？

sentences.en: Well, Moderna and Pfizer's vaccines both need to be frozen.
sentences.zh: 嗯，莫德纳和辉瑞的疫苗都需要冷冻保存。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Johnson & Johnson's is a lot easier to use.
sentences.zh: 强生的疫苗要好用得多。

sentences.en: You just throw it in the fridge.
sentences.zh: 你直接把它扔进冰箱就行了。

sentences.en: And so you can have these mobile clinics driving around with them.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以让这些移动诊所开着车到处跑。

sentences.en: You can bring them to rural areas where they don't have the facilities for keeping frozen vaccines.
sentences.zh: 你可以把它们带到那些没有条件保存冷冻疫苗的农村地区。

sentences.en: I mean, you can do things with a Johnson & Johnson vaccine that you just couldn't do with the other vaccines.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你可以用强生疫苗做一些用其他疫苗绝对做不到的事情。

sentences.en: So, for example, there are people who can't get to a clinic.
sentences.zh: 所以，举例来说，有些人无法去诊所。

sentences.en: They're homebound.
sentences.zh: 他们行动不便，只能呆在家中。

sentences.en: And so if you're going to send out public health workers to get to them with a vaccine, you don't want them to have to be lugging around, you know, big freezers.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你要派公共卫生工作人员带着疫苗去给他们接种，你肯定不希望他们拖着，你知道的，大冰箱。

sentences.en: It's really easy, relatively speaking, to send them out with a Johnson & Johnson vaccine, go into people's homes and vaccinate them and do it once and then you're done.
sentences.zh: 相对而言，派他们带着强生疫苗出门，进入人们的家中为他们接种，做一次就搞定，真的非常简单。

sentences.en: And it also had the advantage of just being one shot.
sentences.zh: 而且它还有一个优势，那就是只需注射一针。

sentences.en: And so a lot of people just really liked the prospect of getting just one dose as opposed to two with Moderna and Pfizer.
sentences.zh: 所以很多人真的很喜欢只打一剂的前景，而不是像莫德纳和辉瑞那样需要打两剂。

sentences.en: So there were going to be a sizable number of people who were going to really benefit from having this option of Johnson & Johnson.
sentences.zh: 因此，将有相当数量的人真正受益于强生提供的这种选择。

sentences.en: And now for the next few days, at least, that's not an option.
sentences.zh: 而现在至少在接下来的几天里，这不再是一个选项了。

sentences.en: Carl, what about hesitancy?
sentences.zh: 卡尔，疫苗犹豫的问题呢？

sentences.en: What might this pause do to and for a U.S.
sentences.zh: 这个暂停可能会对美国公众产生什么影响？

sentences.en: public that already showed signs in some demographics in particular of being skeptical of COVID vaccines despite data, as we talked to you about many times,
sentences.zh: 尽管有我们跟你多次讨论过的数据——

sentences.en: that shows how historically safe and effective all three of these vaccines are?
sentences.zh: 这些数据表明这三种疫苗在历史上是多么的安全和有效，但部分群体的公众已经表现出对新冠疫苗持怀疑态度的迹象。

sentences.en: Well, if people just hear a few words, they might get concerned.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果人们只是听到几个词，他们可能会感到担忧。

sentences.en: They might hear vaccine, blood clot.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会听到疫苗、血栓。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh, that's bad.
sentences.zh: 天哪，这太糟糕了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So really, you know, we're going to have to see how well the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以真的，你知道的，我们拭目以待美国

sentences.en: government handles the messaging of what they're doing in the days to follow.
sentences.zh: 政府在接下来的几天里将如何处理他们所做所为的信息传达。

sentences.en: Because what's crucial for people to understand is that, first of all, this is so far an incredibly rare condition.
sentences.zh: 因为对人们来说，至关重要的是首先要明白，到目前为止，这是一种极其罕见的情况。

sentences.en: If you look at 7 million people who have gotten this vaccine so far in the United States, and we only know of six cases of this particular condition, you know,
sentences.zh: 如果你看一下迄今为止在美国接种这种疫苗的700万人，而我们只知道这种特殊情况的六个病例，你知道的，

sentences.en: that means that 99.99999% of people who got the vaccine didn't get that condition.
sentences.zh: 这就意味着99.99999%接种过疫苗的人都没有得这种病。

sentences.en: So if you're thinking about your odds, well, your odds of getting COVID are way higher right now.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你在考虑你的几率，好吧，你感染新冠的几率现在要高得多。

sentences.en: And the risks you face from COVID of ending up in the ICU and potentially of dying are also, by comparison, incredibly high.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，你因新冠而住进重症监护室甚至可能死亡的风险也高得惊人。

sentences.en: So this is going to be the kind of information that public health officials are going to have to get out and get out clearly in the days to follow.
sentences.zh: 因此，这将是公共卫生官员在接下来的几天里必须明确传达的信息。

sentences.en: What you're describing is essentially a messaging battle for the government.
sentences.zh: 你所描述的本质上是政府的一场信息战。

sentences.en: How easily can it communicate safety and the rarity of these blood clots?
sentences.zh: 它能多大程度上轻松地传达安全性和这些血栓的罕见性？

sentences.en: Do you have any sense yet, based on your reporting, of how the government is thinking of approaching the question of communicating that?
sentences.zh: 根据你的报道，你是否对政府如何考虑处理信息传达的问题有了任何了解？

sentences.en: I think that the theme that the government is hammering on over and over again is that this is how government regulators keep us safe.
sentences.zh: 我认为政府一再强调的主题是，这就是政府监管机构如何保障我们的安全。

sentences.en: That they are keeping a very careful eye on these new vaccines and that even the slightest suggestion of a problem,
sentences.zh: 他们对这些新疫苗保持着非常警惕的关注，甚至哪怕有一点点问题的迹象，

sentences.en: they're going to take it very seriously and look very closely at it.
sentences.zh: 他们都会非常认真对待并进行非常密切的调查。

sentences.en: That's the message.
sentences.zh: 这就是传达的信息。

sentences.en: Carl, so far we have been talking about the domestic impacts of this decision on Johnson & Johnson's vaccine,
sentences.zh: 卡尔，到目前为止，我们一直在讨论这一决定对强生疫苗的国内影响，

sentences.en: but every vaccine maker is attempting to put doses into arms all across the world.
sentences.zh: 但每一家疫苗制造商都在努力将疫苗分发到世界各地。

sentences.en: So is the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: government.
sentences.zh: 政府也是如此。

sentences.en: We all want as many people to be vaccinated as possible in every country.
sentences.zh: 我们都希望每个国家的尽可能多的人都能接种疫苗。

sentences.en: So how, if at all, does this pause impact people outside the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 那么，这个暂停是否以及如何影响美国以外的人呢？

sentences.en: The ramifications of these findings are pretty big right now.
sentences.zh: 目前这些发现的后果相当重大。

sentences.en: Johnson & Johnson was in the process of seeking authorization in Europe for their vaccine.
sentences.zh: 强生公司当时正在欧洲为其疫苗寻求授权审批。

sentences.en: They're putting that on pause for now.
sentences.zh: 他们现在要把这事搁置了。

sentences.en: There were such concerns in Australia that they decided that they're not going to buy Johnson & Johnson vaccines at all.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚有这样的担忧，以至于他们决定根本不购买强生疫苗了。

sentences.en: Wow, that's a very big deal.
sentences.zh: 哇，这可真是件大事。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Johnson & Johnson had promised half a billion doses to an effort called COVAX to get vaccines to lots of countries that might not be able to afford to get them on their own.
sentences.zh: 强生曾承诺向一个名为COVAX的计划提供5亿剂疫苗，以便为许多可能买不起疫苗的国家提供疫苗。

sentences.en: This development throws that into question.
sentences.zh: 这一进展给该计划打上了问号。

sentences.en: It's not clear what COVAX is going to do about this.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚COVAX将对此采取什么行动。

sentences.en: South Africa had been planning on using AstraZeneca to treat their healthcare workers.
sentences.zh: 南非原本计划使用阿斯利康来治疗他们的医护人员。

sentences.en: Then it turned out that AstraZeneca might not be effective against their particular variant of COVID.
sentences.zh: 后来发现阿斯利康可能对他们当地特有的新冠变种无效。

sentences.en: And so they said, that's okay, we'll use Johnson & Johnson.
sentences.zh: 于是他们说，没关系，我们用强生的。

sentences.en: Well, they're probably not going to use Johnson & Johnson for now.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他们现在可能不会用强生了。

sentences.en: So this is having impacts across the world.
sentences.zh: 所以这正在对全世界产生影响。

sentences.en: So given just how high the stakes are here and globally for resuming J&J vaccinations, do you have any sense of how long this pause may last?
sentences.zh: 鉴于恢复强生疫苗接种在国内外关系重大，你是否知道这次暂停可能会持续多久？

sentences.en: You know, if it follows the example of what happened in Europe with AstraZeneca, I think this will be resolved in a few days.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果它效仿欧洲阿斯利康事件的先例，我认为这将在几天内得到解决。

sentences.en: I think what's happening now is that the FDA and the CDC are taking in new reports that might or might not represent more of these cases of these peculiar blood clots.
sentences.zh: 我认为现在发生的情况是，美国食品药品监督管理局和疾病控制与预防中心正在接收新的报告，这些报告可能代表也可能不代表更多此类特殊血栓病例。

sentences.en: And then they're going to look at the data and figure out, well, what do we do next?
sentences.zh: 然后他们将查看数据并弄清楚，好吧，我们接下来该怎么办？

sentences.en: Is this as significant as a risk that we need to adjust how we give the vaccines out?
sentences.zh: 这是否具有我们需要调整疫苗分发方式的重大风险？

sentences.en: One possibility is that they might restrict who gets the vaccine simply to minimize risk.
sentences.zh: 有一种可能是，他们可能会限制接种疫苗的人群，以简单地将风险降至最低。

sentences.en: So far, the six cases are all in women between 18 and 48.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，这六个病例全部发生在18至48岁的女性身上。

sentences.en: Does that mean that this vaccine represents a very small but significant risk specifically for women?
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着这种疫苗对女性而言存在着非常小但却很重要的特定风险？

sentences.en: We don't know yet.
sentences.zh: 我们还不知道。

sentences.en: It could be that a bunch of cases involving men might come in today or tomorrow and then in the next few days.
sentences.zh: 有可能今天或明天以及接下来的几天里会涌现出一批涉及男性的病例。

sentences.en: We'll see.
sentences.zh: 我们拭目以待。

sentences.en: But you could imagine decisions based on age or on sex or other things that might come out in the next few days.
sentences.zh: 但你可以想象，未来几天可能会根据年龄、性别或其他因素做出决定。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: So this could result in an unpausing of the vaccine pretty quickly,
sentences.zh: 所以这可能会导致疫苗相当快地解除暂停，

sentences.en: but one where there are now restrictions and different guidelines about who can get the Johnson & Johnson vaccine in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，现在会有关于美国谁可以接种强生疫苗的限制和不同的指南。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And what people have to recognize is that pauses happen all the time in the world of vaccines and drug development.
sentences.zh: 人们必须认识到，在疫苗和药物开发的世界里，暂停的情况随时都在发生。

sentences.en: There's a huge amount of attention on this particular pause because we're in a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 这次特定的暂停受到了极大的关注，因为我们正处于大流行之中。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But you just have to bear in mind that pauses happen and they happen a lot.
sentences.zh: 但你必须记住，暂停会发生，而且经常发生。

sentences.en: And then generally what happens is that the pause ends and things go forward.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下发生的事情是暂停结束，然后事情继续推进。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: That said, Carl, if you've just gotten the J&J vaccine, this pause period is one where you're craving information.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，卡尔，如果你刚刚接种了强生疫苗，这个暂停期正是你渴望了解信息的时期。

sentences.en: And I wonder what guidance, based on your reporting, should be given to people in that position.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，根据你的报道，应该给处于这种立场的人什么指导意见。

sentences.en: First off, if you've just gotten the Johnson & Johnson vaccine, take a deep breath and remember that this condition seems to be incredibly rare.
sentences.zh: 首先，如果你刚刚接种了强生疫苗，请深吸一口气，并记住这种情况似乎极其罕见。

sentences.en: It may or may not have anything to do with getting this vaccine in the first place.
sentences.zh: 它可能与最初接种这种疫苗有关，也可能毫无关系。

sentences.en: Then, you know, just monitor your health.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，只需监测你的健康状况。

sentences.en: The FDA and the CDC have given a list of symptoms, including severe headache, for example.
sentences.zh: 美国食品药品监督管理局和疾病控制与预防中心给出了一份症状清单，例如包括剧烈头痛。

sentences.en: So if in the three weeks after you get your Johnson & Johnson vaccine, you experience a severe headache, maybe a pain in your leg, call your doctor.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果在你接种强生疫苗后的三周内，你经历了剧烈头痛，或者腿部疼痛，请给你的医生打电话。

sentences.en: Let your doctor know that you're not feeling great and tell them that you got the Johnson & Johnson vaccine.
sentences.zh: 让你的医生知道你感觉不太舒服，并告诉他们你接种了强生疫苗。

sentences.en: And then you and your doctor can take things from there.
sentences.zh: 然后你和你的医生可以从那里采取进一步措施。

sentences.en: The chances are overwhelmingly likely that you're not going to have these problems, that you're not going to be calling your doctor about it,
sentences.zh: 绝大多数情况下，你不会遇到这些问题，你不会为此打电话给医生，

sentences.en: and you're going to come out of this protected from COVID.
sentences.zh: 并且你将从中获得对新冠的免疫保护。

sentences.en: Mm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Which is a very good thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一件非常好的事情。

sentences.en: Which is a very, very good thing.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一件非常非常好 A 的事情。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Well, Carl, thank you.
sentences.zh: 好的，卡尔，谢谢你。

sentences.en: We, as always, appreciate your wisdom.
sentences.zh: 一如既往，我们感谢你的真知灼见。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: I'm now the fourth United States president to preside over American troop presidents in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 我现在是第四位负责美军在阿富汗驻留的美国总统。

sentences.en: Two Republicans, two Democrats.
sentences.zh: 两名共和党人，两名民主党人。

sentences.en: I will not pass this responsibility onto a fifth.
sentences.zh: 我不会把这个责任推给第五个人。

sentences.en: In a speech on Wednesday, President Biden explained his decision to withdraw all American troops from Afghanistan by September 11th,
sentences.zh: 在周三的一场演讲中，拜登总统阐述了他在9月11日之前撤出所有美军的决定，

sentences.en: saying that the United States had achieved its goal of ensuring that Afghanistan would never again serve as a launching pad for a terrorist attack on the United States.
sentences.zh: 并表示美国已经实现了确保阿富汗绝不再充当对美国恐怖袭击跳板的目标。

sentences.en: I've concluded that it's time to end America's longest war.
sentences.zh: 我得出结论，是时候结束美国最长的战争了。

sentences.en: It's time for American troops to come home.
sentences.zh: 是时候让美军回家了。

sentences.en: Biden said that the drawdown would begin on May 1st, the deadline for withdrawal set by his predecessor, Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 拜登表示，撤军将于5月1日开始，这是他的前任唐纳德·特朗普设定的撤军最后期限。

sentences.en: But in a pointed warning, Biden admonished the Taliban against seeking to attack U.S.
sentences.zh: 但拜登在发出严厉警告时，告诫塔利班不要试图袭击美军

sentences.en: forces as they left Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 在他们离开阿富汗的时候。

sentences.en: And the Taliban should know that if they attack us as we draw down, we will defend ourselves and our partners with all the tools at our disposal.
sentences.zh: 塔利班应该知道，如果我们撤军时他们攻击我们，我们将动用我们掌握的所有手段来捍卫我们自己和我们的伙伴。

sentences.en: And?
sentences.zh: 还有呢？

sentences.en: So in my opinion, Mr. Floyd had a sudden cardiac arrhythmia or cardiac arrhythmia due to his atherosclerotic and hypertensive heart disease or...
sentences.zh: 所以在我的观点里，弗洛伊德先生突发心脏心律失常或因动脉粥样硬化和高血压性心脏病导致的心脏心律失常，或者……

sentences.en: On Wednesday, defense lawyers in the murder trial of Derek Chauvin sought to rebut claims that George Floyd died because Chauvin deprived him of oxygen,
sentences.zh: 周三，德里克·肖万谋杀案的辩护律师试图反驳关于乔治·弗洛伊德因肖万剥夺其氧气而死亡的说法，

sentences.en: calling to the stand a former medical examiner for Maryland, Dr. David Fowler,
sentences.zh: 他们传唤了马里兰州前法医大卫·福勒博士出庭作证，

sentences.en: who said that Floyd's heart condition, drug use, and even carbon monoxide from the tailpipe of a nearby car contributed to his death.
sentences.zh: 他表示，弗洛伊德的心脏病、吸毒甚至附近汽车排气管的一氧化碳都导致了他的死亡。

sentences.en: All of those combined to cause Mr. Floyd's death.
sentences.zh: 所有这些因素结合在一起导致了弗洛伊德先生的死亡。

sentences.en: As medical examiner in Maryland, Fowler had previously ruled that the 2018 death of another Black man in police custody,
sentences.zh: 作为马里兰州的法医，福勒此前曾裁定2018年另一名黑人男子在警方拘留期间死亡

sentences.en: Anton Black, was an accident, prompting a lawsuit from Black's family.
sentences.zh: 安东·布莱克是一起事故，这引发了布莱克家人的诉讼。

sentences.en: Finally, prosecutors in Minnesota said they would charge the white police officer who fatally shot Dante Wright, a 20-year-old Black man, with second-degree manslaughter.
sentences.zh: 最后，明尼苏达州的检察官表示，他们将以二级过失杀人罪起诉枪杀20岁黑人男子丹特·赖特的白人警官。

sentences.en: Police officials have said that the officer, Kim Potter, appeared to have shot Wright by accident after mistaking her gun for her taser.
sentences.zh: 警务官员曾表示，涉事警官金·波特似乎在将枪误认为电击枪后意外枪杀了赖特。
